title: Cross-platform generalization predictions for GMKtec EVO-T2 (Platform B / T2S) before first contact
note: T2-3-PREP files predictions before any T2S probe, session, or box contact. No measurement launched. Error on these claims is the generalization claim for the replay.

reference_platform.seam_rule: Never cite ~120 GB/s as measured XPS bandwidth until M2.4. The ~102 figure here is the operator-stated theoretical comparator for this pre-registration only.

bandwidth_ratio.efficiency_assumption: Equal bandwidth efficiency: both platforms realize the same fraction of their theoretical peak memory bandwidth on the decode path. Under that assumption, decode tok/s scales with the theoretical bandwidth ratio (~2.6×). Prefill wall-time scales by the inverse (×102/273) if the same regime remains bandwidth-bound at equal efficiency.
bandwidth_ratio.blueprint_note: Blueprint §risk table lists Platform B ≈136 GB/s (LPDDR5X-8533 × 128-bit, unverified). This prep uses the operator-stated 273 GB/s theoretical (consistent with a 256-bit / dual-128-bit arithmetic) vs XPS ~102 theoretical. Neither figure is an M2.4 measurement.

median_prefill_s.arm_policy: all three CAP-4 KV arms reported; headline representative = gpu_only_f16

median_decode_tok_s.depth_definition: Primary 'at depth' baseline = n=46000 (CAP-4 deep primary rung). Secondary pre-paging check = n=12000.
median_decode_tok_s.caveat_n46000_f16: gpu_only_f16 decode at n=46000 is already collapsed on Platform A (~1.16 tok/s) under CAP-4; treat the ratio claim as applying to arms/depths that remain in a bandwidth-bound non-paging regime. Prefer u8/u4 at 46k or f16 at 12k when scoring.

eight_b_allocation_ceiling.failure: RuntimeError (CL_OUT_OF_RESOURCES / could not execute a primitive)

citing_sessions.note: CAP-3-family 8B gpu_only probe workdir; RuntimeError at n=10000. Not a sealed raw/ run — cite as derived session artifact.
Second 8B gpu_only probe workdir; RuntimeError at n=10000.

related_4b_prior.note: 4B-int4 gpu_only_f16 CL_OUT_OF_RESOURCES at n=8000 (sealed C-2 family); distinct from the 8B n=10000 ceiling.

P1_decode_tok_s_at_depth.claim: T2S decode tok/s at matched depth ≈ 2.6× Platform A (theoretical bandwidth ratio 273/102 ≈ 2.676), under equal bandwidth efficiency.
P1_decode_tok_s_at_depth.efficiency_assumption: Equal fraction of theoretical peak bandwidth realized on the decode path on both platforms.
falsified_if: Measured T2S/A decode ratio at a matched non-paging depth outside [2.0, 3.4]
Decode ratio ≈1.0 (no bandwidth scaling) at equal efficiency-eligible depths
Decode slower on T2S than Platform A at matched n / arm (ratio < 1)

P2_prefill_exponent.claim: T2S gpu_only prefill power-law exponent remains in 2.1–2.2 (property of attention computation, not platform bandwidth).
P2_prefill_exponent.note: Platform A CAP-4 fits span ~2.12–2.25 across KV arms. Prediction for T2S centers the computational claim at 2.1–2.2; f16 on A slightly exceeded 2.2.
falsified_if: Fitted T2S exponent b < 1.9 or b > 2.4 on a comparable fit_range_n
Exponent shifts by >0.3 relative to the matched Platform A arm

P3_prefill_absolute.claim: T2S median prefill_s at n=12000 and n=46000 equals Platform A CAP-4 median × (102/273), i.e. scaled by the inverse theoretical bandwidth ratio (faster = lower prefill_s).
P3_prefill_absolute.evaluable_relative_band_note: Measured / predicted within [0.7, 1.4] counts as held for the absolute-time claim; outside falsifies the pure bandwidth-scaling absolute.
falsified_if: At n=12000 or n=46000, measured/predicted prefill_s outside [0.7, 1.4] on the representative arm (or all three arms)
T2S prefill slower than Platform A at matched n (scale failed directionally)

P4_paging_boundary.claim: No paging-driven quiescence loss on T2S within the CAP-4-comparable sweep range (n ≤ 82000). With 64 GB vs Platform A's 16 GB (4× DRAM), the memory-linear paging onset scales to ~4 × 82000 = 328000 tokens.
falsified_if: Paging-driven quiescence refusal / stop_classification equivalent within n ≤ 82000 on T2S
Available-MB collapse + quiescence refusal pattern of CAP-4 appears at n < 164000 (half the 4× scaled onset)

P5_8b_allocation_ceiling.claim: No 8B-int4 gpu_only allocation / RuntimeError ceiling on T2S within the CAP-3 search / operating range (n ≤ 10000). Platform A hit RuntimeError at 8B/n=10000.
falsified_if: Qwen3-8B-int4-ov gpu_only raises RuntimeError / CL_OUT_OF_RESOURCES / alloc failure at any n ≤ 10000 on T2S
8B fails to load or compile on T2S gpu_only within the same IR / placement

joint_generalization_claim.statement: If P1–P5 hold, Platform A CAP-4 / 8B ceilings generalize to T2S by theoretical bandwidth and DRAM capacity scaling under equal efficiency. If they fail, the failure mode is the published generalization result for the replay — do not silently re-fit.
joint_generalization_claim.no_measurement_confirmation: T2-3-PREP did not launch a probe, session, or contact the T2S box.
